note: The failure mode is losing a fact, not writing an inelegant summary — so almost every case asserts that a specific detail survived the merge. Compaction is the only thing that rewrites what the agent knows, and a dropped number is gone: the note it came from is superseded and nothing downstream will notice the absence. The store keeps the originals regardless, which is what makes the step safe to run at all, but a compaction that quietly loses something is still a compaction that has to be caught here.

cases.note: A specific number stated once among three notes. Rounding it to 'roughly' would lose the reason it was recorded.

notes.text: The host is a Mac with 48 GB of unified memory.
Metal caps GPU-wired memory at about 75% once you go above 36 GB, so the real ceiling is 36 GB rather than 48.
Measured 28 GB resident with three models loaded, which leaves headroom against that ceiling.

cases.note: Same entry, different detail. Two cases rather than one because a merge that keeps the headline number and drops the measurement still reads as complete.

cases.note: A later note corrects an earlier one. The correction is what should survive — silently keeping the superseded figure would leave the store asserting something known to be wrong.

notes.text: The react step is given a 10 second timeout.
10 seconds turned out to be too tight — phi4 stalls occasionally and was tripping it.
Correction: the react timeout was raised to 30 seconds and has been stable since.

cases.note: Two notes disagree and nothing settles which is right. Picking one silently is how a store starts asserting something nobody established; recording both is the honest merge.

notes.text: qwen3-embedding:0.6b is the right size here — under a gigabyte resident.
Retrieval quality with the 0.6b is fine for the gatekeeper prefilter.
Retrieval quality with the 0.6b is noticeably worse than the 4b; the prefilter misses near-duplicates.

cases.note: An empty compaction is refused in code, because superseding several real notes with nothing is the one outcome that genuinely loses an entry. This asserts the model does not produce one in the first place.
